questions.text: Explain how a buffer helps when sending data to a printer.

answer.text: Allows the CPU and printer to work at different speeds
The printer reads data as it becomes ready

questions.text: Compare an SSD and an HDD for a laptop.

answer.text: SSD has no moving parts and is more shock resistant
HDD commonly has lower cost per unit capacity

questions.text: Explain how a touchscreen can act as both input and output.

answer.text: Touch detection sends the position of user interaction as input

questions.text: Describe how an analogue temperature sensor is used by a digital computer.

answer.text: The sensor outputs an analogue signal
An ADC samples and converts it to digital values
